suggestions.quote: A Welshman has been asking to dig his landfill since 2013 (not verified yet) and is still asking.
suggestions.fix: Change 'his landfill' to 'the council landfill' (needs a source): the site is owned and operated by Newport City Council, not Howells, which is why he has had to petition the council for permission to excavate.

suggestions.quote: Three million wrecks on the sea floor (not verified yet), and not one of them a step closer.
suggestions.fix: Frame as an estimate following UNESCO's exact wording ('over three million wrecks' or 'an estimated three million wrecks') with (needs a source), rather than stating an unqualified round count.

suggestions.quote: treasure in the soil worth more than ten rupees is reported and deposited with the Collector, and not reporting can mean up to a year in prison, under an Act from 1878 (not verified yet).
suggestions.fix: When drafting the G2 script line, verify against Section 4 of the Indian Treasure Trove Act 1878 (needs a source): the finder gives notice to the Collector and deposits the treasure in the nearest Government treasury or gives security, rather than handing it directly to the Collector.

keep.quote: The fact, in the Act's own terms: treasure in the soil worth more than ten rupees is reported and deposited with the Collector, and not reporting can mean up to a year in prison, under an Act from 1878 (not verified yet).
